Hi, I'm Zhafira / Fira!

I am a software engineer with 5+ years of experience. Ex-Garena, Microsoft, and YC startup.

I have 680+ hours in Baldur's Gate 3, 250+ in Dragon's Dogma 2 (not counting the new DLC), and I am currently playing Stardew Valley, because I like optimizing business units and delivering shareholder value.

I love gaming and computer science. Outside of being a software engineer, I am also a graduate student at Brown University studying Computer Science, with Applied Mathematics cross-registration at Harvard University.

Academia-wise, I have worked on research at MIT's McGovern Institute and I am currently doing Reading & Research at the Serre Lab at Brown. The lab works at the intersection of neuroscience, cognitive science, computer vision, and AI, and is part of Brown's broader Carney Institute for Brain Science community.
